chunks.text: This week’s kind of a blur — I just realized I’ll be bouncing from Beijing to Shanghai soon, and I haven’t even thought through the flight options yet.
Also, I keep putting off that bill… the one labeled DL20260219001. If it’s still sitting there unpaid, I’d rather just get it taken care of.
On a totally different note, I’ve been meaning to finally start learning guitar — if “Guitar for Beginners” is available, yeah, go ahead and enroll me as He Xia.
